title: Sphynx challenge
description: Metadata, rules and tests for one challenge. Lives in challenges/<id>/challenge.json next to description.md, Starter.java, Starter.classic.java, Solution.java and Solution.classic.java. Guide: docs/creating-challenges.md

id.description: Unique id. Defaults to the folder name, which is recommended: leave this out.

title.description: Name shown in the sidebar and at the top of the problem panel.

topic.description: Group in the sidebar. Variables, Conditionals, Loops, Data Structures, Strings, Methods, OOP, Streams and Tests are listed first, in that order; any other name works too. Leave it out to put the challenge in the "Custom" group (always listed last).

skills.description: Topics this challenge combines, shown as badges in the panel and the sidebar tooltip. Useful for mixed challenges in the "Tests" group, e.g. ["Variables", "Conditionals", "Loops"].

order.description: Position inside the topic (lower comes first).

hints.description: Hints revealed one at a time, from gentle to specific. Plain text.

mustContain.description: Every pattern must match the student's code (comments are ignored), otherwise the message is shown and tests don't run.

mustNotContain.description: No pattern may match the student's code (comments are ignored).

timeLimitMs.description: Time limit per test in milliseconds, including JVM startup.

aiHints.description: Set to false to disable AI hints for this challenge (for example in an exam).

tests.description: Test cases. Visible tests appear as examples and run on Run; hidden tests only run on Submit.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression (multiline mode). Remember to double backslashes in JSON: "\\bfor\\b".

message.description: Shown to the student when the rule fails, and listed under Requirements in the panel.

input.description: Exactly what the program receives on standard input. End lines with \n.

output.description: Expected standard output. Trailing spaces and trailing blank lines are ignored. Leave empty and run "Validate Challenges → fill in expected outputs" to generate it from Solution.java.

hidden.description: Hidden tests run only on Submit and never reveal their input. Use them for edge cases.
